openmp.scope: available OpenMP team probe outside timer; Accelerate actual worker count is unmeasured

thread_policy: Environment budget set before BLAS; Accelerate worker count is not measured.
initialization: xorshift32 uniform[-0.01,0.01); zero seed maps to 0x9e3779b9
final_loss_phase: after timed updates on last mini-batch; evaluation excluded from timer
scope: Short real Wiki RAM-resident CPU timing; includes window gather and updates; no complete epoch or quality comparison

corpus.load_scope: file_read_RAM_load including validation; OS file-cache state uncontrolled, not cold SSD I/O
corpus.sampling_policy: deterministic C affine permutation, coprime multiplier, unique targets per pass; differs from legacy hash sampler

phase_scope: non-overlapping caller wall time; includes scheduling waits and timer overhead; excludes warmup and final evaluation
exponential_implementation: Apple Accelerate vForce vvexpf CPU vector API
cpu_scope: boundary snapshots around timed update loop; process/rusage include all process workers, thread is calling thread only; setup/warmup/final evaluation and checksum scans excluded
per_update_scope: wall intervals and non-overlapping phase deltas; overall wall also includes record bookkeeping; no per-update JSON or allocation inside timed loop
